title: An Engineering Reading of the Bounded Halting Problem and Observable Properties of a Universal Machine
abstract: arXiv:2611.06303v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The halting problem asks whether a program eventually halts, with unrestricted resources. Engineering systems instead certify bounded halting: given a program, an input, and a step budget T, decide whether the program halts within T steps. This paper studies two of its uses. First, it defines an exact finite-budget problem, placing the simulated program and the checker on the same unit-cost timescale, so the checker can be embedded in an adversarial program. A diagonal argument with explicit additive overhead shows that no fixed deterministic checker decides every instance within any fixed fraction of T below one, for large T. In the nondeterministic case, T bounds the branch depth allowed for a stable observable decision. Second, bounded-halting instances give adversarial tests for finitary universality, since a universal model must support arbitrary finite computations as T grows. translated_title: 有界停机问题的工程学解读与通用机的可观测性质
translated_abstract: 停机问题问的是一个程序在资源不受限制的情况下最终是否会停机。工程系统则转而认证有界停机：给定一个程序、一个输入和一个步数预算 T，判定该程序是否会在 T 步内停机。本文研究了这一问题的两种用途。首先，论文定义了一个精确的有限预算问题，将被模拟的程序与检查器置于同一个单位成本的时间尺度上，从而使检查器可以被嵌入到对抗性程序之中。一个带有明确加性开销的对角线论证表明，对于较大的 T，不存在任何固定的确定性检查器能够在小于 1 的任意固定比例的 T 内判定所有实例。在非确定性情形下，T 限制了实现稳定可观测判定所允许的分支深度。其次，有界停机实例为有限通用性提供了对抗性测试，因为一个通用模型必须随着 T 的增长支持任意有限的计算。这些测试检验资源随 T 的增长情况以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将停机问题工程化地改写为给定步数预算 T 的有界停机判定问题，通过带明确开销的对角线论证证明任何固定确定性检查器都无法在 T 的任意固定比例内判定所有实例，并将有界停机实例用作检验计算模型有限通用性与可观测性质的对抗性测试。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts the halting problem as bounded halting with an explicit step budget T, proves via a diagonal argument with explicit additive overhead that no fixed deterministic checker can decide every instance within any fixed fraction of T, and uses bounded-halting instances as adversarial tests for the finitary universality and observable properties of universal computational models.
